findings.evidence: Existing useful-completion guidance did not distinguish HTTP-200 proxy counts from caller terminal gRPC outcomes. Protocol permits HTTP 200 with nonzero grpc-status.
findings.consequence: Faster failures or partial messages could be counted as successful completed RPCs, approving an unsupported gain.
findings.correction: Added a short main-workflow guard and conditional consumer-outcome section. Inspect query/format and caller result, separate stream progress, logical calls and attempts, then correct affected report/query conclusions while retaining independent evidence.

findings.evidence: Envoy 1.36.0 getGrpcStatus reads trailers, then headers, then an HTTP-derived fallback; a raw trailer lookup can miss a trailers-only response stored as headers.
findings.consequence: A formatted gRPC field can be inferred; missing fields or proxy-only outcomes cannot be silently promoted to caller success.
findings.correction: Documented actual operators, source extraction order and observation limits; no mandatory logging/filter rollout.
